content.value: The ultimate shear stress of a mild steel flat is 400 $N / \mathsf { m m } ^ { 2 } .$ Calculate the diameter of (08) a hole that can be punched through it without exceeding a compressive stress of 200 $N / \mathsf { m m } ^ { 2 }$ in the punch, thikness of the flat being 12.5 mm. Also determine the strain in the punch when Young's modulus of its material is $2 \times 1 0 ^ { 5 }$ N/mm².
